_about: Local Wisdom notes: things written on the city, shown in Explore on the place or district they belong to. Every note carries who wrote it (author) and when (date), so anything odd can be traced back and, if needed, taken out. Today only Eko and Nib write notes. Later the agent NPCs from the Adyta sim write into this same file with author 'agent:<id>', and later still players with 'player:<name>'. 'signed' is the in-world signature players see; 'author' is never shown. status: draft until it goes to Nib, canon after.

notes.text: Elevator B works if you kick the panel and say please. In that order.
notes.author: eko

notes.text: Ma Dresk's fryer oil is changed every Sunday. Eat Monday.
notes.author: eko

notes.text: Read the plaque above the bar before you start anything.
notes.author: eko

notes.text: Rent on this side: 40. Rent on that side: ask what they think you're worth.
notes.author: eko

notes.text: If your face is up here, somebody loved you or somebody's looking for you.
notes.author: eko

notes.text: Knock on the pipe, not the door. The door is decorative.
notes.author: eko

notes.text: Returns accepted. Exchanges negotiated. Refunds are a myth from another dimension.
notes.author: eko

notes.text: Baba knows. Just pay for the hand pie.
notes.author: eko

notes.text: Rung seven is a liar. Skip it.
notes.author: eko

notes.text: If you sign a lease here, sign it in daylight.
notes.author: eko

notes.text: Crews eat first. Wait your turn and the broth gets better.
notes.author: eko

notes.text: Leave a lantern lit if you need a hand. Leave it dark if you need to not be found.
notes.author: eko

notes.text: Smokier's chair stays empty until Smokier sits in it. Don't ask.
notes.author: eko

notes.text: Every roof has a name. Learn it before you walk on it.
notes.author: eko
